headline: Committee will select a vendor for the district's equity audit under RFP 26064.
summary: The committee will review proposals from multiple vendors and select one to conduct the equity audit under RFP 26064. The meeting also covers next steps after the selection.
items: Selection of a vendor for the equity audit (RFP 26064)
